messages:
Sam: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to Elena and Diego for swooping in during yesterday's sync and rescuing the live demo. Execs left smiling, and the feature rollout stayed on schedule. :tada:
Elena: Team effort! Diego spotted the cache key mismatch, Priya validated the fix, and I pressed deploy. Mostly really fast teamwork. :relieved:
Diego: I mostly screamed at logs and then fixed a typo in a config 😅. Glad it didn't eat the demo.
Maya: Also — brought a 'banana bounty' to the kitchen after that meeting. If anyone wants one, help yourselves (box labeled "deploy snacks").
Sam: Official kudos — can someone add a 1-line to the weekly all-hands wins? I want this captured.
Priya: On it. Will add: "Demo saved by cross-team triage (Elena, Diego, Priya) + ops snacks courtesy of Maya". Tagging execs.
Elena: Oh wow thanks! No need to make it long. :blush:
ops-bot: Incident INC-4217 created for cache warmup failures — linked to PR #1834 and assigned to @Diego.
Diego: Nice, thanks ops-bot. Priya helped reproduce locally which let me iterate faster.
Sam: Small celebratory decision: paper card + team note, or snacks-only? Vote with emoji: :thumbsup: for card, :heart: for snacks-only.
Maya: :heart: (I stand by the snacks)
Elena: :thumbsup: (but also snacks)
Diego: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Poll recorded — 3 votes card, 1 snacks-only, 1 heart (snacks champion).
Sam: Card it is. Priya, can you draft a 1-liner for the all-hands and I'll sign the card?
Priya: Drafted and added to the shared doc. Linking here: https://redwood/doc/all-hands-wins (edited)
Diego: Coffee on me next week for the triage crew ☕️
Maya: Also small PSA — please eat the ripe bananas soon (no experiments). :joy:
Sam: Closing with massive thanks to everyone who jumped in — small gestures, big impact. :raised_hands:
